approach: Weather moved off the canvas into compositor-only DOM layers (CSS transform/opacity animations). No per-frame full-screen fill; the GPU only re-composites cached textures.
layer_order: backdrop canvas -> .wx weather div -> sprite/HUD canvas (transparent, clear dirty rects only)

rain.tile: rain_tile_256_f0.webp (frame 0 of the approved tile; canvas createPattern only ever showed frame 0)
rain.motion: x -60 px/s (4.2667 s per 256), y +700 px/s (0.36571 s per 256), nested divs

storm.motion: same as rain in this harness
storm.tint: div rgb(18,24,48) opacity .28 mix-blend-mode multiply (static, not repainted)

lightning.impl: .wx-flash div: white fill + lightning_bolt_1.webp, opacity animation with steps(); peak 0.55
lightning.game_rule: drive via JS class toggles to follow spec sequence 60 on/50 off/70 at .35/220 fade; max 3 flashes per 10 s; never >0.55; .reduce-flashing disables

fog.impl: 2 repeat-x strips 256 px tall, width 100%+1024, translateX loop 512 px

perf: perf_results_lite_thr4.json (current), perf_results_lite_thr4_prev.json (previous iteration), perf_results_lite.json (unthrottled, capped at 60)
